ideas.title: Investigating Federal Funding Freezes
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent trend of federal funding freezes, including those related to healthcare and education
questions: What is the cause of the federal funding freezes?
How many programs have been affected?
ideas.insight: I believe this story is important because it may indicate a larger issue with the allocation of federal funds. By investigating the cause and scope of these freezes, we may be able to uncover a significant story.
